doc_summary: native_visuals coloured lights accept radii from 0.25 through 32 blocks and centres within 64 blocks of the render camera. Only the first eight native light requests are examined; at most 16 lights are selected after merging native, particle and pack sources. RGB, intensity, finite-value and loaded-chunk checks stay unchanged, as do player-relative rim limits. Bundles relying on these wider light limits require hooks @API:visual_light_limits@ or newer.
